app.title: Dream Book
onboarding.title: Welcome
onboarding.intro: A few settings, then we begin. Everything stays on this phone or computer; nothing is sent anywhere.
onboarding.role.help: The Dreamer works on their own dream. The Dream Friend is the person who accompanies them: leads the meeting for each module, listens and asks questions. "Both": two people who both do the course and take turns being each other's Dream Friend.
onboarding.config: How we go through the course
onboarding.config.solo: One Dreamer and their Dream Friend
onboarding.config.help: Choose how you do the course. In each module, the "With your Dream Friend" section opens on the chosen variant; the other two stay one tap away. If you chose the Dream Friend role, pick "One Dreamer and their Dream Friend" or "Dream Friend and a group".
onboarding.start: Date of the first meeting with your Dream Friend
onboarding.paper: I keep my dream list on paper
onboarding.paper.help: The Dream Book is the notebook you write in by hand. If you tick this, the app does not ask you to copy your dreams here; you note only how many dreams are in the notebook and, from module 2, the dream you work on.
onboarding.lang: Interface language (the course text is in Romanian)
home.next.none: No first-meeting date set yet. Set it in Settings.
home.next.allDone: You have completed every module available so far. The next ones are coming; until then, keep up the dream list and your plans.
home.plans.none: No plan yet. You write one at the end of each module, in "Until next time".
home.chosen: The dream I am working on
home.chosen.none: No dream chosen yet. You choose the dream you work on in module 2.
home.friendMode: At the next meeting I am the Dream Friend
home.friendMode.help: Tick this when you are the Dream Friend at the next meeting: the "With your Dream Friend" exercises switch to the Friend's perspective and the Dream Friend page appears in the menu.
modules.title: Modules
modules.locked.none: You can open any module at any time. We recommend the order below.
module.friend.variant.solo: One Dreamer and their Dream Friend
module.next.plan: Turn what you will do until next time into a concrete plan: "if [situation], then [action]". For example: if it is Sunday evening after dinner, then I write three dreams in my book.
module.next.if.placeholder: e.g. it is Sunday evening after dinner
module.next.then.placeholder: e.g. I write three dreams in my book
module.next.saved: Plan saved. You will find it on the Home page.
module.feedback: One word for how this module was for you
module.takeaways.placeholder: What stayed with you from this module: an idea, an exercise, an aha moment. Two or three lines are enough; you reread these notes in the last module.
module.contentFallback: The course text is only in Romanian; the interface is in the language chosen in Settings.
module.notFound: There is no module with this number. Choose a module from the list.
dreams.title: The 100 dreams list
dreams.add.label: A new dream
dreams.paper: You keep the list on paper. Here you note only how many dreams are in your notebook and, from module 2, the dream you work on.
dreams.paper.count: How many dreams have you written in your Dream Book (notebook)?
dreams.tag.help: From inside: growth, relationships, contribution, health. From outside: money, image, status.
dreams.score: Importance (1 = low, 10 = huge), by your criteria below
dreams.choose: Choose this dream (I work on it)
dreams.release: Let this dream go (stays in the list, marked)
dreams.warn.extrinsic: Your highest-scored dreams are all "from outside" (money, image, status). Not wrong, but worth a pause before choosing the dream you work on.
dreams.criteria.help: Write the criteria you use to score each dream's importance, in your own words (for example: "brings me closer to my family"). One criterion is always there and cannot be deleted: "how I feel when I think of this dream".
dreams.criteria.fixed: How I feel when I think of this dream
dreams.criteria.placeholder: e.g. brings me closer to the people I love
dreams.empty: The list is empty. Type your first dream in the field above; maybe a childhood one.
letter.label: Letter of the COPIL method
book.title: Dream Book
book.intro: Printable sheets. Choose a sheet or print the whole book. A4 or Letter, black and white.
book.sheet.rating: My importance criteria and scores (from module 2)
book.sheet.soon: The next sheets come with the next modules.
friend.title: Dream Friend page
friend.hidden: This page appears only when the chosen role is Dream Friend or Both. Change the role in Settings.
friend.notes: My notes as Dream Friend (kept apart from my own list and plans)
friend.notes.placeholder: e.g. spoke easily about childhood dreams; got stuck at the written list
settings.title: Settings
settings.role.help: What I do on this device.
settings.config: How we go through the course
settings.config.help: In each module, the "With your Dream Friend" section opens on the chosen variant; the other two stay one tap away.
settings.lang: Interface language (the course text is in Romanian)
settings.import.err: The file could not be read. Choose a .json file saved from this app.
settings.danger: Delete all data on this device
settings.danger.confirm: Delete everything? This cannot be undone. Save a copy first if you want to keep anything.
settings.privacy: Nothing leaves this device. A saved copy is the only way data goes out, and only you start it.
role.help.dreamer: I work on my own dream. I see the modules, the dream list and the book.
role.help.friend: I accompany someone else on the road to their dream. I do not work on a dream of my own here; I see the meeting plans and my notes.
role.help.both: I work on my dream and I am also the Dream Friend for someone else: by turns, in a pair, or all the time, when I lead a group.
config.help.solo: One person works on their dream and someone close accompanies them at the meetings, without doing the course themselves.
config.help.pair: Two people both do the course and take turns being the Dream Friend for each other.
config.help.group: One Dream Friend runs the meetings for 3–8 people who each work on their own dream.
sources.title: Sources and credits
combo.pairNeedsBoth: In a peer pair you both work on your own dream and take turns being the Dream Friend. That is why the role on this device becomes "Both".
combo.friendNoPair: With the Dream Friend role you cannot choose "Peer pair": a pair has no Friend who is not doing the course.
combo.bothNeedsPartner: With the role "Both" you need someone whose Dream Friend you are: choose "Peer pair" or "Dream Friend and a group".
picker.step1: Step 1 of 2: my role on this device
picker.step2: Step 2 of 2: how we go through the course
picker.pickRole: Choose a role to see the next step.
picker.pickConfig.dreamer: Choose: you work with a Dream Friend who is not doing the course, or in a group run by a Dream Friend.
picker.pickConfig.friend: Choose: you accompany one Dreamer, or you run a group.
picker.pickConfig.both: Choose: a pair in which you take turns as Dream Friend, or a group that you lead while also keeping your own list.
settings.change: Change the role or how we go through the course
config.help.group.both: You lead the meetings and, alongside, keep your own dream list and share from it in the group. Note: nobody in this group is your Dream Friend, so nobody asks you the questions. If you want someone to accompany you on your own dream, run a separate peer pair with another Dream Friend.
settings.export.help: Creates a file with all your data (dreams, plans, notes, settings). Keep it as a backup or send it to your Dream Friend. Nothing is sent automatically.
settings.import.help: Choose a file saved earlier from this app. It replaces everything currently on this device.
mydream.title: My dream
mydream.none: You have not chosen a dream to work on yet. Choose one on the Dreams page, with the button "Choose this dream".
mydream.clarify.help: Answer in writing, with details you could photograph. Answers save themselves when you leave the box.
clarify.clarity.q: What does this dream look like in real life? What do you do, where, with whom, when?
clarify.clarity.placeholder: e.g. next summer, ten days on foot through the Apuseni mountains, with my sister, with a tent
clarify.imagine.q: Close your eyes: what do you see around you, as in a photograph? Light, places, objects, faces.
clarify.imagine.placeholder: e.g. fog in the valley in the morning, the backpack wet with dew, my sister making coffee on the stove
clarify.feel.q: What do you feel in that moment?
clarify.feel.placeholder: e.g. calm, pride that I kept going, tired and happy legs
clarify.anchor: Anchor (what ties you to this dream)
clarify.anchor.q: Why does this dream matter for who you are?
clarify.anchor.placeholder: e.g. because at 12 I promised myself I would see the mountains on foot, not from a car window
clarify.act.q: What is one small step you can take this week?
clarify.act.placeholder: e.g. I take my sister out for a coffee and tell her the plan
mydream.routes: Three routes to the same dream
mydream.routes.help: Three different ways the dream could come true. You do not choose one yet; you just see them all.
mydream.route.placeholder.1: e.g. ten days in one go, next summer
mydream.route.placeholder.2: e.g. three long weekends this year
mydream.route.placeholder.3: e.g. with an organised group, if my sister cannot come
book.col.question: Question I answer
week.title: My week
week.intro: Write 5–8 things you usually do in a week, at home or at work, plus one step toward your dream; then put each in the box that fits it. The list saves itself.
week.add.label: A thing I do
week.add.placeholder: e.g. answer messages for an hour
week.empty: The list is empty. Type the first thing in the field above; for example, what you usually do on Monday morning.
week.move: Put in the calendar this week
week.when: Day and hour in the calendar
week.reflect.1: Which box holds most of your things?
week.reflect.3: Can you move something from one box to another?
week.reflect.4: Which thing from "Plan" do you put in the calendar this week?
woop.title: The obstacle (WOOP)
woop.help: Four lines, in this order. For the obstacle, look for what you do when things get stuck, not what you lack from outside.
woop.wish.q: The chosen dream, in one sentence, as you clarified it.
woop.wish.placeholder: e.g. next summer, ten days on foot through the Apuseni mountains, with my sister
woop.outcome.q: The best thing that happens if it comes true. How do you feel then?
woop.outcome.placeholder: e.g. I feel strong and free; my sister and I have something of our own again
woop.obstacle.q: What in you stops you most often? A habit, an emotion, an excuse.
woop.obstacle.placeholder: e.g. in the evening, when I would have time to look up trails, I open my phone and do not stop
woop.plan.q: "If the obstacle appears, then I…": one concrete action, written in advance, with the obstacle in the "if" part.
woop.plan.placeholder: e.g. if it is 9 pm and I have the phone in my hand, then I put it to charge in the kitchen and open the notebook
mydream.section.friends: Module 4 · People with a good heart
habit.title: The small step
habit.help: One sentence in three parts. The step must be smaller than feels normal: under two minutes.
habit.anchor.q: Something you already do every day, after which the step comes.
habit.anchor.placeholder: e.g. After I pour my morning coffee,
habit.behaviour.q: A thing so small you can do it even on your worst day.
habit.behaviour.placeholder: e.g. I open the notebook and read the dream.
habit.celebration.q: What you do right after, to tell yourself "well done".
habit.celebration.placeholder: e.g. Then I smile and put a tick in the notebook.
habit.sentence.empty: Your recipe will appear here as one sentence.
habit.log.help: Each week, tick "the habit happened" if you did the small step on at least five days out of seven, and write the sentence you sent your progress partner. Keep the log until the end of the course and three months after.
habit.note.label: Sentence sent to the progress partner in the week of {date}
habit.note.placeholder: e.g. I opened the notebook 5 days out of 7 and looked up two trails
friends.title: People with a good heart
friends.help: Three people on your dream's side, one role each. It can be three people or the same person in two roles (write their name twice). Tell them what you did, not who you want to become.
friends.name: Person {n}
friends.role.friend: the one who is glad with me
friends.role.friend.help: Any close person who is glad when I tell them what I did and whom I look up to.
friends.role.progress.help: The one you write one sentence a week to, about what you did.
friends.role.ask: the person I ask something of
friends.role.ask.help: Advice, an introduction, an hour of help: something concrete.
friends.ask: My ask, written as a sentence I will actually say
friends.ask.placeholder: e.g. Mihai, you walked the Apuseni; can you give me an hour on Sunday to tell me which trail you would pick for two beginners?
friends.day: Day of the week I write to them
friends.print: Print the "People with a good heart" sheet
fear.title: Fear and good enough
fear.help: Two short answers. Fear is not a bad thing; it moves you, unless it freezes you.
fear.fear.q: What fear hides behind the obstacle you wrote on the "Obstacle (WOOP)" sheet?
fear.fear.placeholder: e.g. that I will embarrass myself if I do not last ten days
fear.goodEnough.q: What would "good enough" look like for your dream, so you do not wait for perfect?
fear.goodEnough.placeholder: e.g. three days on foot, with a tent, and wanting to go again
fear.print: Print the "Fear and good enough" sheet
book.sheet.friends: People with a good heart (from module 4)
calm.title: Calm
calm.intro: The voices that pull you back, the part of you that sees clearly, and a photograph of your life today. Everything saves itself.
profile.title: My saboteurs and strengths
profile.help: From the saboteur test (in English; the test names are in brackets) pick the three voices with the highest score, leaving out the Judge, which we all have; from the strengths questionnaire write the top five in your own words.
profile.saboteurs: The three voices with the highest score
profile.saboteurs.note: The names are given, playfully, to thoughts we all have; not a diagnosis and not a label about who you are.
profile.uses: A strength, used in a new way
profile.uses.help: One week, every day: a single strength, used in a new way, tied to the dream. Write what you did.
profile.uses.what: What I did with it today, differently from usual
profile.uses.placeholder: e.g. I called a mountain guide and asked him three things about the Apuseni
profile.print: Print the "My saboteurs and strengths" sheet
sab.judge.desc: The voice that scolds you for mistakes, scares you with what could go wrong and finds what is wrong with others and with life. We all have it.
sab.vigilant.desc: Constant worry: something will go wrong, be careful. Keeps you up at night and makes you check three times.
sab.achiever.desc: You are worth what you achieve. Today's success is never enough either; the next one will bring peace, but it does not.
sab.controller.desc: If you do not run it, it falls apart. You push others, get angry when they do not listen, cannot stand aside.
sab.stickler.desc: It is not good enough. Order, rules, everything in its place; a small mistake is a big shame.
sab.victim.desc: Nobody understands how much you suffer. It promises that if the suffering shows, help will come, and good things seem to happen to others.
sab.rational.desc: Feelings are a waste of time. You analyse everything from a distance, and people feel like noise in the way.
sab.pleaser.desc: You cannot say no. You give all the time, to be accepted, and silently resent not getting back.
sab.restless.desc: The next thing will be better. Always busy, always bored by what is now, hard to keep on one thing.
sab.avoider.desc: Better not get involved. You go around what is hard or unpleasant, postpone conflicts and call it peace.
journal.title: The "catch the saboteur" journal
journal.help: Every time you get angry, scared or stuck: five minutes, six lines. The last line is the one that matters.
journal.happened.placeholder: e.g. my boss asked me to redo the report
journal.thought.placeholder: e.g. I got it wrong again, I am not able
journal.felt.placeholder: e.g. shame, a knot in my stomach
journal.did.placeholder: e.g. I sat for an hour doing nothing
journal.friend: What I would tell a friend who was in my situation
journal.friend.placeholder: e.g. you have redone reports dozens of times; take it in pieces
journal.empty: No entry yet. Press "Write an entry" after the first time a voice catches you.
journal.print: Print the "Catch the saboteur journal" sheet
rep.title: The short attention exercise
rep.help: Notice the voice ("that is the Judge"), then move your attention to one sense until it rings. Once a day, two weeks.
rep.sense.touch: Rub two fingers together and feel the lines of the skin.
rep.sense.sound: Listen for the farthest sound you can catch.
rep.sense.breath: Breathe and feel the air going in and out through your nose.
rep.sense.sight: Look at one object and notice its colours and edges.
rep.sense.weight: Feel the weight of your body on the chair or on your feet.
rep.done: Done. What changed in your body?
rep.videos.help: In English, about two minutes each: one on how the voices that pull you back can become gifts, one with a short attention exercise led by voice.
rep.videos.credit: Recordings with Shirzad Chamine, from the Positive Intelligence program (on the Sources page).
wheel.title: Wheel of life
wheel.help: Eight slices, a score from 0 (not satisfied at all) to 10 (as satisfied as can be) for each. A photograph of today, not a test; you redo it in three months.
swls.title: Five statements about my life
swls.help: For each statement, how much you agree, from 1 (not at all) to 7 (completely). The questionnaire has been used in research since 1985 (on the Sources page, under "Life satisfaction").
swls.ideal: In most ways my life is close to my ideal.
swls.conditions: The conditions of my life are excellent.
swls.satisfied: I am satisfied with my life.
swls.gotten: So far I have gotten the important things I want in life.
swls.again: If I could live my life over, I would change almost nothing.
home.work.help: The sheets you fill in during the course, all in one place.
